༄༅/ /shes rab ky-i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po nyi shu lnga pa skad gnyis shan sbyar ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// shes rab ky-i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po nyi shu lnga pa skad gnyis shan sbyar ba bzhugs so//

rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wa tī pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā hṛ da ya/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ na mo bha ga wa tī pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā ye/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// e waṃ asmin shrā wa ye ka wa ye le/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bha ga wa te rā dza gṛha gṛdha kū ṭa parba te/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab/ bya rgod phung po'i ri na/ bhik+ṣu ma hā saṃgha/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang*/ bo dhi satwa ma hā saṃgha sat+taṃ tiṣ+ṭha tiḥ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so// ten kā len bha ga wa te gaṃ bhīr wā bha nā ma dharma par+ya ya s+ya sa mā dhi sa ma ni khi shi wān/྄ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// ten kha lu su no bo dhi satwa ma hā satwa dh+yā wa lo ki te shwa ra tsa pā ra mi tā gaṃ bhīr ts+yai'ar dṛṣ+ṭa pañca skan+dha sa yis pra krita shū n+yaṃ bi dṛṣ+ṭa/ a tha bud+dha nu bhā wen/ a yu ṣ+yaṃ shā ri pu tre ṇa/ yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i spyod pa nyid la rnam par lta zhing*/ bo dhi satwa ma hā satwa s+yā wa lo ki te shwa raṃ e waṃ mok+ta/ go tra pu tra kul di ru ka yaṃ/ ya kat+ya pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā gaṃ bhīr tsar+yā tsā ṇaṃ kā ma te/ ya thā shak+ṣa ka ro mi/ e waṃ na mo kāk+sha tsa/ bo dhi satwa ma hā satwa s+yā wa lo ki te shwa re ṇa a yuṣ+yaṃ shā ri pu traṃ e waṃ nā mo3/ phung po lnga po de dag la yang rang bzhin gyis stong par rnam par lta'o// de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so// rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa des ji ltar bslab par bya/ de skad ces smras pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras shā ri pu tra go tra go tra ku la dā ri kā ya ye kat+ya pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā gaṃ bhī ra tsar+yā tsā ri ṇa kā ma te/ ta thā hi dṛṣ+ṭa ka ro mi ti/ pañca skan+dhe pa ya sa pra kri ten shū n+ya samyakā nu dṛṣ+ṭaḥ rū pa shū n+yāṃ/ shū n+yā ta rū pya/ rū pā ta/ pi shū n+yā tā n+ya thā/ shū n+yā t ta pi rū pā n+ya thā/ ta thā na saṃdz+nyā saṃskā ra/ gzigs dbang phyug gis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so// shā ri bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa des 'di ltar rnam par blta ba bya ste phung po lnga po de dag kyang rang bzhin gyi stong par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ */ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// bi dz+nyā nā ni shū n+yā ta/ shā ri pu tra tasmat+ta dhi sarba dharma shū n+yā ta/ a lak+ṣa ṇa/ a nut+pan+na/ ni rū d+dha/ a ma la/ a bi ma la/ no ū na no pūr+ṇa ka/ shā ri pu tra tasmat+ta r+hi shū n+yātaṃ/ a rū pa/ a be da na/ a saṃskā ra/ a bi dz+nyā na/ a nai tra/ a shro tra/ a nā sa/ gzugs las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ */ de bzhin du/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pa rnams stong pa'o// shā ri'i bu/ de ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid de/ mtshan nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags pa/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma dang bral ba med pa/ bri ba med cing*/ gang ba med pa'o// a dzi hwa/

a kā ya/ a ma na/ a rū pa/ a shapad/ a gan+dha/ a ra sa/ a spar+sha/ a dharma/ a nai tra dhā tu/ a ma na dhā tu/ a ma na s+ya bi dz+nyā na dhā tu ma dh+yā si/ nir bid+yā/ nir bid+yā k+ṣa ya/ a dza ra ma ṇaṃ/ a dza ra ma ṇaṃ k+ṣa ya ma dh+yā sa/ e waṃ duḥkha sa mu da ya/ shā ri'i bu/ de lta bas na/ stong pa nyid la gzugs med/ tshor ba med/ 'du shes med/ 'du byed rnams med/ rnam par shes pa med/ mig med/ rna ba med/ sna med/ lce med/ lus med/ yid med/ gzugs med/ sgra med/ dri med/ ro med/ reg bya/ chos med do// mig gi khams med pa nas yid kyi khams med/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar du yang med do// ma ni ro dha/ a mārga/ a dz+nyā na/ a prap+ta/ a prap+ta san+ti/ shā ri pu tra tasma d+da dhi bo dhi satwa nāṃ kra dra snyā na tasmi ta pradz+nyā pā ra mi te yaṃ bha go ni ke taḥ tsit+taṃ no ā war+ṇaṃ.a to traṃ/ kim+pi lā kā yat+pa wā ra tiḥ nir+wā ṇaṃ naṣ+ṭhi ga taḥ ṭi ka la ka ti byā si n+ya sarba bud+dha bhu yo pradz+nyā pā ra mitā/ ma rig pa med/ ma rig pa zad pa med pa nas rga shi med/ rga shi zad pa'i bar du yang med do// de bzhin du/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ kun 'byung ba dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ lam med/ ye shes med/ thob pa med/ ma thob pa yang med/ shā ri'i bu/ de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni thob pa med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la brten cing gnas te/ te ha bha wa ྅ nu t+ta ra samyak+saṃ pūr+ṇa/ bodh+ya bhi saṃ pūr+ṇa bh+ya d+dhaḥ tasmat+ta dha pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā man+t+ra/ ma hā bid+yā man+t+ra/ a nut+tar man+t+ra/ a sa ma sa ma ka ra man+t+ra/ sarba duḥkha pra shān+ta ka ra man+t+ra/ no mṛ ṣa sma ta sat+yaka dz+nyāro mi te/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā s+ya man+t+ra uk+taṃ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pā ra ga te sems la sgrib pa med pas skrag pa med de/ phyin ci log las shin tu 'das nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar phyin to// dus gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la brten nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i bya chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so// de lta bas na/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags/ rig pa pā ra saṃ ga te bo dhi swā hā/ shā ri pu tra bo dhi satwa ma hā satwenaiwaṃ hi pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā gaṃ bhī ra shak+ṣa ka ra ṇaḥ a tha bha ga wān sa mā dhi ta yo tar+thir te/ bo dhi satwa ma hā satwa r+ya lo ke shwa raṃ sā dhu ka ra ma hā ta/ sā dhu sā dhu go tra pu tra te te thā te ta thā ta/ ya thā twa yo da sha nai waṃ/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā gaṃ bhī raṃ/ chen po'i sngags/ bla na med pa'i sngags/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam par byed pa'i sngags/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ mi brdzun pas na bden par shes par bya ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags smras pa/ 'di lta ste/ 'dud do gshegs ma gshegs ma pha rol tu gshegs ma yang dag par gshegs ma byang chub tu gzhi tshugs/ shā ri'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu tsar+yā ka ro mi te/ ta thā ga ta ya si a nu pra t+ya yi teḥ bha ga wānai wāṃ na man+t+ra ya te sa ma/ a yu ṣ+yaṃ shā ri pu tra bo dhi satwa ma hā satwar+yā wa lo ki te shwa ra/ sarba bā na raṃ sar+ṣat+ta yau de wa nar a su ra sa gan+dharba s+ya lo ka pra t+ya yi te/ bha ga wān bho ṣi ten bha s+t+wa tradaḥ ār+ya pañca bing+sha ti pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā s+yaṃḥ phyin pa zab mo la bslab par bya'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ legs so legs so// rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no// de de bzhin te/ ji ltar khyod kyis bstan pa de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad par bya ste/ gar+bha samyak+sa map+ta/ pradz+nyā gar+bha bho ṭa s+ya tu t+ta pā saṃskṛ ta s+ya tu tā ya tsa mā ri ra tri ka dwi bha ṣi dharma kīrtenā brtiḥ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang rjes su yi rang ngo*// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/

tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang*/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// bcom ldan 'das kyi 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po nyi shu lnga pa yang dag par rdzogs so// shes rab snying po bod kyi skad la legs par sbyar ba 'di/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad du 'bri gung pa skad gnyis smra ba chos kyi grags pas bsgyur ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// shes rab snying po shan sbyar 'di'i ma dpe dbu med bris rnying la song*/ ma gsal ba dang sngags yig brtsegs ma rnams ji bzhin rtogs dka' bar brten/ nor 'khrul mchis rigs la slad zhib 'jug gnang bar rigs so// //
